top_signals.title: Comcast turns your Xfinity WiFi into a home motion detector
top_signals.summary: Comcast is promoting WiFi-based motion detection as a part of its new Xfinity Shield home protection platform, allowing routers and wireless devices to detect people moving through a home without cameras or motion sensors. [...]
